_help: Pop-up cards the host can fire at any moment. type: quick (fastest three get double coins), goal (if enough of the class is right, coins rain on everyone; goal = fraction needed, bonus = coins each), fact (tap for a coin).

cards.title: Powerhouse check
cards.text: How many ATP does one glucose yield in aerobic respiration (roughly)?
cards.why: Glycolysis and the Krebs cycle make a few, and oxidative phosphorylation makes the bulk: about 30–32 ATP.

cards.title: Class challenge: central dogma
cards.text: Put it in order: DNA → ? → protein
cards.why: DNA is transcribed to RNA, and RNA is translated to protein.

cards.title: Whoa: your DNA
cards.text: If you uncoiled all the DNA in one of your cells, it would be about 2 meters long. All of yours together would stretch to the Sun and back many times.

cards.title: Name that bond
cards.why: Dehydration synthesis joins amino acids with peptide bonds.

cards.title: Class challenge: cell boss
cards.text: Which organelle packages and ships proteins?
cards.why: The Golgi modifies, sorts and ships proteins from the ER: the cell's post office.

cards.title: Whoa: you're outnumbered
cards.text: Your body hosts roughly as many bacterial cells as human cells. Your microbiome helps digest food and trains your immune system.

cards.title: Water potential
cards.why: Water always flows down its water potential gradient, from high Ψ to low Ψ.

cards.title: Genetics speed round
cards.text: A trait shows up in males far more often than females. Most likely…
cards.why: Males have one X, so a single recessive allele shows. Colorblindness and hemophilia are classic examples.

cards.title: Class challenge: ecology
cards.text: Organisms that make their own food are…
cards.why: Producers capture energy, usually sunlight, and fuel the entire food web.

cards.title: Whoa: tardigrades
cards.text: Tardigrades can survive drying out, near-absolute-zero cold and even the vacuum of space by entering a dormant state called a tun.

cards.title: Membrane trivia
cards.text: Which molecule crosses the phospholipid bilayer most easily?
cards.why: Small nonpolar molecules like O₂ and CO₂ slip right through the hydrophobic core.

cards.title: Class challenge: the final FRQ
cards.text: In an experiment, the variable you change on purpose is the…
cards.why: Independent = what you change. Dependent = what you measure. You've written that a hundred times!

cards.title: Photosynthesis lightning
cards.text: Where does the Calvin cycle happen?
cards.why: The light reactions happen on the thylakoids, and the Calvin cycle fixes CO₂ in the stroma.

cards.title: Whoa: you share genes with bananas
cards.text: Humans share a surprising number of genes with bananas, like ones for basic cell machinery. Life really is one big family tree.
